definitions.explanation: A condition or circumstance that puts one in a worse position.

examples.japanese: この{条件|じょうけん}は{我々|われわれ}に{不利|ふり}だ。
examples.english: These conditions are disadvantageous to us.

examples.japanese: {不利|ふり}な{立場|たちば}に{立|た}たされた。
examples.english: I was put in a disadvantageous position.

examples.japanese: {被告|ひこく}に{不利|ふり}な{証拠|しょうこ}が{出|で}てきた。
examples.english: Evidence unfavorable to the defendant came out.

notes:
USAGE: {不利|ふり} describes situations, conditions, or evidence that work against someone's interests.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{不利|ふり}な{条件|じょうけん} (unfavorable conditions)
・{不利|ふり}な{立場|たちば} (disadvantageous position)
・〜に{不利|ふり}だ (to be disadvantageous to ~)
・{不利益|ふりえき} (disadvantage, harm)

ANTONYM: {有利|ゆうり} (advantageous)
